title: Improving Reconstruction of Representation Autoencoder
author: Siyu Liu; Chujie Qin; Hubery Yin; Qixin Yan; Zheng-Peng Duan; Chen Li; Jing Lyu; Chun-Le Guo; Chongyi Li
summary: The paper introduces LV-RAE, an improved autoencoder that better reconstructs images while keeping important semantic features. It shows that decoders in high-dimensional spaces are sensitive to small changes, causing errors in image generation. LV-RAE adds noise during training to make the decoder more robust and improve the quality of generated images.
